title: Nature's Battle Axe
description: This mod adds a truly unique battle axe. Available for Forge!
body:
This mod was inspired by the weapons from the game KurtzPel (if you're not familiar with it, just check out the video “KurtzPel - Wild Spirit”). I'd appreciate it if you could [buy me a cup of coffee!](https://boosty.to/darkbirdra/donate)

[![support me on Boosty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce388857b379f484c41f25c911f25bc342a275ea.png) ](https://boosty.to/darkbirdra/donate)

________________________________________________________________________________________________
![Minecraft art in the style of the painting “Nature's Battle Axe”](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5173ae1927dad495cd288e1ff8334f8ee23eedd7_0.webp)

This mod adds a brand-new weapon to Minecraft: the **Nature's Battle Axe**
________________________________________________________________________________________________
# ✨ Features
**Unique combat system:** The axe has its own attack animations (redstone particles) and mechanics that depend on whether you use:
![lcm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ca6f17f6ed6ee057b099519f4e82eebd78deba0.gif)


![rcm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47f7124f33b2a418eb848a1d3c726acd2cef7224.gif)
  
**Creative Mode Only (for now):** In this early version, the axe cannot be crafted or found in Survival mode. You can obtain it through the Creative mode inventory or using commands.

## 🚀 Planned Features (Coming soon)
Crafting recipes suitable for Survival mode.
Custom, original sound effects for attacks.
Separation into client and server components to enable multiplayer gameplay.

________________________________________________________________________________________________
**Note:** Future development will focus on the PvP aspect, and additional weapon mods related to this mod will be released in the future.
